title: JSON Path Parser
description: Write a Zig program that parses a simple JSON path expression and extracts the corresponding value from a nested JSON-like structure.
hints: Split the path string on '.' to get individual segments
Use `for (path, 0..) |ch, i|` for iteration with index
Slice the string with `path[start..i]` to extract substrings without allocation
